strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Encrypted Channel via Asymmetric Cryptography across OS Platforms

analytics.name: Analytic 1496
analytics.guidance: Processes not typically associated with encryption loading asymmetric crypto libraries (e.g., rsaenh.dll, crypt32.dll) and subsequently initiating outbound TLS/SSL connections with abnormal certificate chains or handshakes. Defender correlates process creation, module load, and unusual encrypted sessions.

tuning.description: Whitelist browsers, mail clients, or apps expected to use asymmetric crypto.
Baseline CA list for validating abnormal certs.
Detection of incomplete or malformed handshakes.

analytics.name: Analytic 1497
analytics.guidance: Processes (e.g., bash, python, custom binaries) dynamically linking libcrypto/libssl for RSA key exchange, then creating external connections with abnormal certificate validation or handshake anomalies. Defender observes syscall traces and outbound asymmetric key exchanges from non-SSL-native processes.

tuning.description: Baseline libraries that normally handle asymmetric crypto.
Threshold for client-heavy data sending vs server.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve or socket/connect system calls for processes using RSA handshake

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: Non-standard processes negotiating SSL/TLS key exchanges

log_sources.name: linux:osquery
log_sources.channel: Processes linked with libssl/libcrypto performing network activity

analytics.name: Analytic 1498
analytics.guidance: Applications or launchd services invoking RSA or public-key routines from the Security framework, followed by outbound SSL/TLS sessions with unrecognized certs or anomalous handshakes. Defender observes unified logs of API calls and suspicious network entropy.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Process invoking SecKeyCreateRandomKey or asymmetric crypto APIs

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: TLS connections with abnormal handshake sequence or self-signed cert

analytics.name: Analytic 1499
analytics.guidance: VMware services (hostd, vpxa) unexpectedly negotiating asymmetric crypto sessions to external endpoints outside vCenter or update servers. Defender sees encrypted handshakes in logs inconsistent with baseline ESXi communication patterns.

log_sources.name: esxi:vpxd
log_sources.channel: ESXi process initiating asymmetric handshake with external host

log_sources.name: esxcli:network
log_sources.channel: Socket inspection showing RSA key exchange outside baseline endpoints

analytics.name: Analytic 1500
analytics.guidance: Encrypted sessions detected with asymmetric key exchange anomalies on non-standard ports or with invalid/malformed certs. Defender correlates NetFlow/IPFIX with IDS/IPS detecting RSA exchanges outside expected TLS flows.

tuning.description: Define expected ports for asymmetric cryptography (e.g., 443, 993).

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Flow records with RSA key exchange on unexpected port

log_sources.name: IDS:TLSInspection
log_sources.channel: Malformed certs, incomplete asymmetric handshakes, or invalid CAs
